ideas.pitch: A heavily optimized low-center-of-gravity RC sumo bot featuring a slanted titanium-tipped front wedge to slide under opponents and lift their drive wheels off the ground.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Robo Sumo: Push the opponent's robot completely out of the ring using an RC-controlled robot within 350x350mm and 3kg limits.
ideas.title: Wedge-Lock Low-CG Sumo Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on fundamental physics (low center of gravity and wedge geometry) which dominates sumo matches, mirroring the physical build and live-demo execution patterns from winning hardware projects.

ideas.pitch: A 4-wheel omni-drive sumo bot controlled via wireless RC, allowing rapid sideways evasion and lateral pushing maneuvers to outflank standard differential-drive opponents.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Robo Sumo: Push the opponent's robot completely out of the ring while demonstrating robot control, mechanical design, maneuverability, and strategy.
ideas.title: Omni-Maneuverable Lateral Shifter Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maneuverability is explicitly judged; omni-directional strafing provides a massive tactical advantage in a single-elimination knockout format against traditional tank-steer bots.

ideas.pitch: A high-traction, high-torque dual-motor-per-side tracked sumo bot engineered with high-friction silicone treads to maximize grip against the arena floor.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Robo Sumo: Push the opponent's robot completely out of the ring while demonstrating robot control, mechanical design, maneuverability, and strategy.
ideas.title: High-Torque Gearbox Traction Sumo Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches judges' criteria on mechanical design and raw pushing power, drawing from the robust physical build approach of past hardware competition winners.

ideas.pitch: An RC-controlled tactical sumo bot equipped with a controlled mechanical linkage lifter to destabilize and flip opposing contenders during close-quarters grappling.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Robo Sumo: Push the opponent's robot completely out of the ring while demonstrating robot control, mechanical design, maneuverability, and strategy.
ideas.title: Active-Defense Pneumatic Flipping Wedge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Incorporates active mechanical strategy beyond simple pushing, ensuring high scores for mechanical design and creative match tactics.

ideas.pitch: A compact, heavily armored 3kg steel-plate chassis designed to absorb impacts and withstand high-speed collisions in the single-elimination knockout rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Senior Robo Sumo: Push the opponent's robot completely out of the ring while demonstrating robot control, mechanical design, maneuverability, and strategy.
ideas.title: Modular Heavy-Armor Box Sumo Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Prioritizes structural durability and reliability—critical traits for surviving a brutal single-elimination tournament where surviving matches is half the battle.
